entries.title: Crystal Garden in a Dissolving Pool
entries.description: A cluster of semi-transparent crystal rods slowly grow upward from a shallow water plane while surrounding crystals dissolve and shrink, with color-changing tips, falling particles, and a floating meter showing total mass gained vs. lost.
